title: At age 36, Cam Heyward led the NFL in snaps at defensive tackle

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: At age 36, Cam Heyward led the NFL in snaps at defensive tackle
sources.description: It's not unusual for older players to get a reduced workload, but Steelers defensive tackle Cam Heyward accomplished something extremely impressive in 2025: He was both the NFL's oldest defensive tackle, and the defensive tackle who played the most snaps.
